name: Secrets, Supply Chain & Repository Security

controls.public_firebase_web_api_key: allowlisted only in firebase-applet-config.json when valid public Firebase web config; never allow service-account/private keys

principle: Do not introduce dependency, platform, or deployment changes without a concrete finding.

firebase-applet-config.json.type: Firebase Web SDK public client API key
firebase-applet-config.json.reason: The Firebase browser SDK requires this identifier in client code; it is not a service-account credential. Restrict it to required APIs and authorized HTTP referrers in Google Cloud Console.
